info.about: Steins;Gate is a 2009 science fiction visual novel game developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus. It is the second game in the Science Adventure series, following Chaos;Head.
info.trivia: The visual novel's first Western console release, published by PQube in 2015.
info.why: A small print run for a text-heavy game, and the Vita version was never reprinted.
